propositions: A plan edited mid-review continues through all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time, wasting billing and checkpoints keyed by the original material fingerprint.
The cancel detection must scope to own material only (excluding relation snapshot and ticket store revision) to avoid false mid-run cancels on unrelated ticket writes that would reintroduce bug d70a.

Own-material change detection is probed at exactly two between-pass seams (after finders before verify, after decide before coach) via lightweight single-ticket reads that avoid fetch/reconverge and sync-lock acquisition.

A detected mid-run own-material change raises PlanReviewCancelledStale, short-circuits coach/verify recovery paths, and returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with cancelled-stale finding and exit code 2, skipping signing and sidecar emission.
The cancel token is a ContextVar scoped to the review run and propagates to pool workers via copy_context, making in-flight chunk operations fail-open when the event is set.
